# Mission 1 (level99)

The first mission, a tutorial: a combat course taught lesson by lesson, a section on getting around the streets, and a
finale that hands over to the second mission. Coney starts it from a new game at checkpoint 1.

## Run it in Coney {#run}

With your own disc ([Playing a level](../guides/building.md#playing-a-level)); `--checkpoint` picks where it starts, 1
to 3:

```text
coney --disc /path/to/disc --play-level level99 --checkpoint 1
```

Its disc test (needs `CONEY_DISC`; [Building](../guides/building.md)):

```text
coney_tests "[disc][story]"
```
